summary: Verified Whisper STT and white-label changes for SIRIUS HUD. Backend: 6/6 pytest passed including a real TTS->STT round trip ('Bonjour Sirius, quelle heure est-il' → transcript contains 'sirius' and 'heure'), error handling for no-file (422), empty file (400), and garbage audio (graceful 500/200), white-label HTML (title='SIRIUS', no #emergent-badge, no 'Made with Emergent', no posthog), and /api/chat 'qui t'a créé' answer contains 'partel'. Frontend: title verified, setup→HUD flow works, footer shows 'v1.0 — partel', text command 'qui t'a créé' returns 'J'ai été créé par partel.', 'raconte une blague' returns a demo-mode French answer, and the mic toggle button (data-testid='sirius-mic-btn') is clickable and degrades gracefully when permission is denied (shows 'Accès au micro refusé', no crash).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/stt writes upload to a .webm temp file regardless of actual MIME (caller may send audio/mpeg or audio/webm). Whisper handles both via file extension hint but consider preserving the original extension from upload.content_type for clarity.

transcribeAndProcess in App.js silently swallows fetch errors (catch{}) — user only sees a generic message even for network or 500 responses. Consider logging response.status to the console subtitle (for power users) for easier mic debugging.
Mic flow has no max-duration safeguard: if user forgets to click the mic again the recording runs indefinitely, uploading a huge blob. Add an auto-stop after ~30s of recording.
test_credentials: No login required. Backend uses EMERGENT_LLM_KEY for Whisper/TTS fallback.
seed_data_creation: TTS-generated mp3 used as STT input (in-memory only).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mic data-testid is 'sirius-mic-btn' (NOT 'sirius-mic'). Web preview cannot grant real microphone access (no --use-fake-ui-for-media-stream exposed by automation tool), so MediaRecorder→/api/stt e2e via mic UI is only verifiable in packaged Electron build. Backend /api/stt verified via direct TTS->STT round trip. STT test file: /app/backend/tests/test_sirius_stt.py.
